prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 14 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Recreate the reference video [Video 1] shot for shot, in one continuous take: the same bright open kitchen with the white floor, the black cabinets, the white stools, the white loft balcony above and the tall window on the right, the same fixed phone camera, framing, timing and dance moves. The ONLY change: the woman on the left, a little further from the camera, is now the person in [Image 1], and the woman on the right, closer to the camera, is now the person in [Image 2]. Both still wear the matching red-and-green plaid Christmas pajamas from the video, barefoot.

Dancer 1 (left) = the person in [Image 1], in EVERY frame: copy the exact face from [Image 1]: face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles exactly as in the photo. NO long platinum-blonde hair unless [Image 1] shows it.

Dancer 2 (right) = the person in [Image 2], in EVERY frame: copy the exact face from [Image 2]: face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles exactly as in the photo. NO long platinum-blonde hair unless [Image 2] shows it.

The same real people in every frame, from the first second to the last, so their friends instantly recognize them, also during the spin and when they walk up to the camera at the end. Never morph, never drift back to the original dancers' faces, never add or remove facial hair. Do not mix the two faces: [Image 1] is only dancer 1 on the left, [Image 2] is only dancer 2 on the right, and they never swap places. Both change: no one from the video stays.

The dance, matching the reference second by second, on the beat, with straight, deadpan faces that break into laughs at the end. Do not invent additional moves.
0-2.5 s: both stand side by side, hands at the collar, then on the hips, swaying the hips.
2.5-5 s: rolling arms and small side steps in sync.
5-8 s: dancer 1 points at dancer 2, then both bump and hop with the arms swinging.
8-9 s: both turn a quick full spin, the hair flying.
9-12.5 s: hands on the chest, rolling arms, one hand points up, then both raise their fists and clap.
12.5-14 s: both step toward the camera, laughing.

Anatomy rules: one head per person, on that person's own shoulders. A face never appears on knees, legs, hands or clothes. Exactly two people. Natural balance, believable steps, stable ground contact.
No dialogue throughout the entire video. No background music.
No extra dancers, no duplicate bodies, no extra limbs, no fused fingers, no text, no captions, no logos, no watermark.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: kling-3-motion, 12 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Use the reference image as the sole character identity reference and the reference video as the motion reference. Animate exactly one adult dancer, in the place from the reference image. Preserve the person's recognizable face, hairstyle, skin tone, body proportions, outfit, shoes, and accessories throughout the video. Follow the reference dancer's movement order and timing, including the hip sways with the hands at the collar and on the hips, the rolling arms, the small side steps, bumps and hops, the quick full spin, the hands on the chest, the arm pointing up and the raised fists, with a straight, deadpan face. Do not invent additional moves. Keep the body visible from the head to at least the knees, with enough space around both hands. Follow the reference framing and camera movement. Maintain natural balance, believable steps, stable ground contact, and consistent shadows. Keep the face recognizable during the spin. No extra dancers, duplicate bodies, extra limbs, fused fingers, outfit changes, new camera cuts, text, or watermark. Use a vertical 9:16 reference and output when supported.
No long platinum-blonde hair and no white short pajamas with a pink print unless the reference image shows them.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 11 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Recreate the reference video [Video 1] shot for shot, in one continuous take: the same festive party hall with the stage, the red banner, the colored stage lights, the two lit Christmas trees and the shiny dark floor, the same fixed camera, framing, timing and dance moves. The ONLY change: the kitten on the left is now the pet in [Image 1], and the kitten on the right is now the pet in [Image 2].

Dancer 1 (left) = the pet in [Image 1], whole body, in every frame: the same species and breed, head shape, muzzle, eyes, ears, fur colors, fur length, markings and body shape as in [Image 1], with the natural body volume and proportions of that animal: never flattened, squashed, stretched or merged with anything, so its owner instantly recognizes it. Not the coat of the kitten on the left in the video.

Dancer 2 (right) = the pet in [Image 2], whole body, in every frame: the same species and breed, head shape, muzzle, eyes, ears, fur colors, fur length, markings and body shape as in [Image 2], with the natural body volume and proportions of that animal: never flattened, squashed, stretched or merged with anything, so its owner instantly recognizes it. Not the coat of the kitten on the right in the video.

Both change: no kitten from the video stays, from the first second to the last. Do not mix the two pets: [Image 1] is only the pet on the left, [Image 2] is only the pet on the right. Both stand upright on their hind legs like people the whole time. If an image shows a dog or another animal, that animal dances in the same place with the same moves.

The dance, matching the reference second by second, on the beat. Do not invent additional moves.
0-4 s: both stand side by side facing the camera, front paws held up at the chest, swaying and bouncing on the beat.
4-5 s: the pet on the left lifts one front paw.
5-9 s: front paws at the chest again, small bounces and side sways in sync.
9-11 s: both spread their front legs and raise one front paw high, waving on the beat.

Anatomy rules: one head and one tail per pet. Two hind legs on the floor and two front legs, no extra legs or paws, no human hands. Exactly two animals. Natural balance, stable ground contact.
No dialogue throughout the entire video. No background music.
No people, no extra animals, no new text, no captions, no logos, no watermark.
